0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_000
0.description: We have patients here who can't feed themselves, so I have to keep that in mind when I'm making the meals. It's not easy work, but it does have its rewards.

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_010
1.description: Why are you looking at me like that? There's nothing wrong with the food, I swear!

2.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_020
2.description: Ahaha...hahaha... Tesleen, taken? Wicked Light, surely you jest? Hahaha...

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_030
3.description: Tesleen may be gone, but her share of the work still needs to be done. I'm sure she wouldn't want us to let standards slip.

4.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_040
4.description: I wish that Tesleen were here to see the stars in all their glory...

5.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_050
5.description: Though the world may be going through all sorts of upheaval, I still have a job to do.

6.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LAMON_00630_LAMON_000_060
6.description: I don't wish to sound ungrateful, but the dark of night does make it rather hard to see what I'm doing. I've burned the stew on more than one occasion.
